lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bin doojaa avar na koi ||
lines.translation: There is no one except You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too kar kar vekhahi jaanahi soi ||
lines.translation: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak guramukh paragat hoi ||4||2||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit saravaraRai bhaeele nivaasaa paanee paavak tinahi keeaa ||
lines.translation: In that pool, people have made their homes, but the water there is as hot as fire!

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)kaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dekhaa tah doobeeale ||1||
lines.translation: In the swamp of emotional attachment, their feet cannot move. I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ek na chetas mooR manaa ||
lines.translation: In your mind, you do not remember the One Lord-you fool!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You have forgotten the Lord; your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa hau jatee satee nahee paRiaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: I am not celibate, nor truthful, nor scholarly. I was born foolish and ignorant into this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pranavat naanak tin kee saranaa jin too naahee veesariaa ||2||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord! ||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaee paraapat maanukh dehureeaa ||
lines.translation: This human body has been given to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d milan kee ih teree bareeaa ||
lines.translation: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||
lines.translation: Nothing else will work.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat bhaj keval naam ||1||
lines.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewel of the Naam. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰੰਜਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਨ ਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sara(n)jaam laag bhavajal taran kai ||
lines.translation: Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam brithaa jaat ra(n)g maaiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are squandering this life uselessly in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have not practiced meditation, self-discipline, self-restraint or righteous living.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have not served the Holy; I have not acknowledged the Lord, my King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ham neech kara(n)maa ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, my actions are contemptible!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮਾ ॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saran pare kee raakhahu saramaa ||2||4||
lines.translation: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, preserve my honor! ||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sohilaa raag gauRee deepakee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Sohilaa ~ The Song Of Praise. Raag Gauree Deepakee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai ghar keerat aakheeai karate kaa hoi beechaaro ||
lines.translation: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted and contemplated

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarihu sirajanahaaro ||1||
lines.translation: -in that house, sing Songs of Praise; meditate and remember the Creator Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum gaavahu mere nirabhau kaa sohilaa ||
lines.translation: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jit sohilai sadaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit nit jeeaRe samaaleean dekhaigaa devanahaar ||
lines.translation: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tere daanai keemat naa pavai tis daate kavan sumaar ||2||
lines.translation: Your Gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)bat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel ||
lines.translation: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come, gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਅਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dehu sajan aseesaReeaa jiu hovai saahib siu mel ||3||
lines.translation: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadaRe nit pava(n)n ||
lines.translation: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadanahaaraa simareeai naanak se dih aava(n)n ||4||1||
lines.translation: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhi ghar chhi gur chhi upades ||
lines.translation: There are six schools of philosophy, six teachers, and six sets of teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur gur eko ves anek ||1||
lines.translation: But the Teacher of teachers is the One, who appears in so many forms. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa jai ghar karate keerat hoi ||
lines.translation: O Baba: that system in which the Praises of the Creator are sung

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: so ghar raakh vadaaee toi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: -follow that system; in it rests true greatness. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: visue chasiaa ghaReeaa paharaa thitee vaaree maahu hoaa ||
lines.translation: The seconds, minutes and hours, days, weeks and months,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਵੇਸ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sooraj eko rut anek || naanak karate ke kete ves ||2||2||
lines.translation: And the various seasons originate from the one sun; O Nanak, in just the same way, the many forms originate from the Creator. ||2||2||
